resources.string: Official QQ · Built-in desktop and LAN access
Started · Check account status inside QQ
After installation, QQ starts automatically and the desktop opens when its window is ready. You can pause, resume or stop the download.
About 198 MiB from Tencent. Pause and resume supported.
Opening QQ prepares the desktop and restarts QQ if its startup profile changed; otherwise it reuses the session. Sign in inside QQ if needed. Leaving this page keeps it running.
Access the same QQ desktop from another device
Your phone and browser share one desktop and QQ session. Enable access in the settings at the top right; no separate startup is needed.
No Wi-Fi or Ethernet address found. Connect to your local network first.
Off by default · Desktop password required
Saving with access enabled prepares the desktop. Enter its password in the browser to connect. Disabling access or changing ports keeps QQ running. Enable only on a trusted local network.
Enter a port from 1024 to 65535, excluding reserved local ports 5920 and 6081.
Keep sign-in data and the built-in desktop
Stop standalone QQ and remove its program. Keep sign-in data, desktop and LAN settings. Continue?
Open the graphical desktop without starting QQ
Also stops QQ and LAN access
Stopping the desktop also stops standalone QQ, LAN access and managed programs that depend on this desktop. Continue?
Repair the desktop offline using bundled components. Robot services, extensions and terminals stop temporarily. Services resume afterward; reopen terminals manually. Continue?
Bundled desktop resources are incomplete or failed verification. Reinstall the complete APK and retry.
The QQ window did not become ready. Check runtime logs and retry.
